headline: Historian Kerri K. Greenidge and Her Book ‘The Grimkes’ Come Under Fire
context: Kerri K. Greenidge appeared to lose her professorship at Tufts University after scholars began scrutinizing her 2022 book, “The Grimkes,” which is no longer listed on its publisher’s website.
